review_scope: Three target strategies only; all 215 source records reviewed. References describe extracted events, not independently watched footage.

claims.exact_qualified_statement: Start on enemy Rogue with enemy Priest Sap/control. The recorded Rogue opener is the default, but some labels reflect chip damage or absorbed attacks; Priest-first commitments also recur.
claims.applicable_context: Observed extracted 2v2 episodes; no unobserved player intent, universal priority, or guaranteed success. Solo/trade outcomes are separately identified.

Recorded Rogue opener does not establish substantial enemy damage. Friendly Rogue under severe pressure; brief enemy control is defensive, both enemies remain nearly full. Shadowfiend is an offensive event.

Priest selected for Sap stays healthy; actual first attack is enemy Rogue. Enemy Priest escape is spent during control but Rogue retains escape. Friendly Priest dies before any low enemy; solo Priest damage branch excluded from intact-team families.

Enemy Priest selection during Rogue Blind/Sap lacks meaningful damage evidence. Recommit Rogue after control reset; Priest spends during it and Kick interrupts Flash Heal. Short unnamed Rogue defense/recovery precedes another Rogue finish.

First Rogue attack draws escape but brief Blind ends and enemy heals. Friendly survival recovery and Priest escape spend precede renewed Rogue attempt. Enemy Hymn then Horror interruption and renewed Rogue damage; Priest target selection is control.

Rogue escape and friendly controlled/disengaged interval precede Priest return. Confirmed Rogue Blind/Sap covers it; Priest spends during attack and reaches 13%. Loss scoreboard with no death established; termination unknown.
Long concealed phase before actual Rogue attack with enemy Priest free. Friendly Priest dies before enemy Rogue Trinket spend; late solo extraction is excluded from team setup.

Early Priest damage after Rogue opener draws Priest escape; Hymn heals both. Enemy Rogue escape then precedes return Rogue. First return heals with free Priest; renewed Rogue stuns and confirmed Priest Fear/Blind support later finish.

Enemy Rogue escapes Sap before substantive attack. Direct Rogue commitment under enemy Priest Fear; Priest retains escape. Fear ends before death, no separate Horror established.

Enemy Hymn fully heals first Rogue attack after escape. Priest switch during Rogue Blind draws Priest escape, later Rogue attempt heals from 7%. Last Priest pressure modest; victory without enemy death established.

Brief Rogue pressure draws escape before Priest switch; Priest spends during attack. Enemy offensive Blind interrupts friendly Rogue; confirmed Rogue Blind covers later healer depletion but exact pre-switch application not established.

Priest escape already spent before shallow Rogue offensive branch. Priest switch includes initially absorbed real attacks. Rogue control expires before kill and Rogue escape spend belongs to cleanup; do not infer a pre-switch escape depletion requirement.

Priest escape and Blind precede Rogue damage. Rogue escape and concurrent Priest depletion to 49% precede brief Priest switch; renewed Rogue control accompanies switch. Actual spread damage, not presumed target vulnerability.
